results.title: Tunnel Vision
results.overview: Four boys, Aryan, Philip, Fletcher, and Nabeel have gotten used to life isolated from the real world, but on Aryan’s 100th day in the strange world, he attempts to find a final escape.

results.title: Laundry Day
results.overview: Laundry Day is an outrageous, slapstick take on 1980's creature-features like Gremlins, Ghoulies, Critters, and The Blob. Once young Billy finds himself returning to his hometown after graduating university, he discovers the world in under threat from a full-scale attack from... sentient socks? Can Billy save the day, get the girl, and get back home in time to watch re-runs of A Country Practice?

results.title: Act Your Age
results.overview: Years after the cameras stopped rolling, a former child actor begins the difficult work of confronting what happened behind them.

results.title: Memento Mori
results.overview: Memento Mori is a techno-horror short film about Silas, a man in his thirties who works as a content moderator. His job pushes him to the brink as he repeatedly wades through extremely violent and sexually explicit videos and imagery. These repeated viewings cause him to obsess over his mortal and corporeal self, spiraling him into mind-bending departures from reality. His existential concerns are compounded only further as he grieves the death of his father and a past that continues to haunt him.

results.title: Working Title
results.overview: Follows the moments of an individuals consumption, only to display that he no longer understands the mechanics of his desire, only that he wants.

results.title: Cathodic Descent
results.overview: An analog horror short film by melon_manga. Inspired by films from the MUBI Fest Buenos Aires 2026 lineup.

results.title: Railfan
results.overview: A curious, heartwarming documentary following a photographer as he makes a portrait series of autistic kids who love New York City subways. While overlooked by many, subways retain a magic in their ability to transport us to the destinations of our choosing. For autistic children, they can mean so much more. Following a group of these unique kids in New York City, Railfan explores the deep fascinations that autistic people have (a.k.a. “special interests”) through gentle observation, and invites you into a secret world where imagination and urban geographies overlap.

results.title: Tobyhanna
results.overview: Ten friends go on a trip to Tobyhanna, Pennsylvania and realize there is more to the world than what they had ever expected.

results.title: In the Stillness of the Night
results.original_title: In the Stillness of the Night
results.overview: At dusk, solitary voyagers glide quietly through the island rainforest on their nightly insect hunt. Hawai’i’s loneliest mammal, the ‘ōpe’ape’a (Hawaiian hoary bat), continues a tradition begun thousands of years before humans arrived, unaware of dangers posed by human hands encroaching steadily, and destructively, into their forest home.

results.title: The Spoon
results.overview: A young Taiwanese woman Kai spends a summer day with German relatives at an allotment. At lunch they make a surprising discovery: one of the spoons has a swastika engraved on it. In the ensuing discussion different ideas come up about what to do with the artefact.

results.title: Haunted House
results.overview: A local businessman wants to demolish an old house where children spend their time playing and growing up, in order to make room for parking his trucks. Luka, one of the boys, seeks help from a monster he believes lives in the house. But when that help comes in the form of his father being injured during the demolition, Luka begins to believe that he is responsible for the accident.

results.title: The Beauty of Static Shots
results.overview: A quiet look at the vibrant everyday life inside a busy market captured entirely through still frames

results.title: Dolphin Flip
results.overview: A preppy weirdo rich kid falls for a down-and-out punk rock skater girl who blows his world open with new experiences, good, bad, ugly, weird, and everything in between.

results.title: A Familiar Pain
results.overview: Some politicians argue that buying a gun should be as simple as getting a driver’s license. But will having more guns actually protect your family? Flávio Bolsonaro and his allies want to make it even easier to access firearms in Brazil. When the Jair Bolsonaro administration relaxed gun regulations, legally purchased weapons ended up in the hands of organized crime, while women and children became even more exposed to violence. In the final episode of the season, Alessandra Orofino, general director of *Revelando*, reveals how the Bolsonaros’ gun policy has put even more Brazilian lives at risk.

results.title: Image Interjections
results.overview: A short collection of spontaneous images and sounds merged in one film.
